label: Rich Rendering
rationale: GPT code interpreter handles diagram generation; DI_Architect judges structure before execution. Output surfaces as a living artifact in DIW, not a flat download.

label: Documents
rationale: Gemini's large context window and Google Workspace integration make it ideal for research-backed documents and decks. DI_Chronicler anchors biographical coherence; DI_Emissary handles external presentation.

label: Code
rationale: GPT excels at code generation and debugging across languages; its code interpreter allows live execution. DI_Architect provides structural review before output.

label: Creative
rationale: Claude produces high-quality prose and long-form coherence. DI_Mirror reflects without judgment; DI_Weaver finds cross-session patterns to enrich the narrative.

label: Visual
rationale: GPT DALL-E enables on-the-fly image and infographic generation. DI_Emissary handles external-facing visual translation.

label: Data / Analysis
rationale: GPT code interpreter runs queries, computes, and returns structured analyses. DI_Witness documents findings with neutral precision.

label: Context-Aware
rationale: Gemini aggregates multi-source context at scale. DI_Weaver connects cross-session threads; DI_Chronicler ensures biographical continuity in synthesized copy.
